name: 24 Hats Leadership Blog
desc: Weekly writing on people focused leadership, healthy teams, and stronger relationships, drawn from the 24 Hats Leadership Podcast.
hero_title: People focused leadership, one post a week.
hero_lede: Each week we take an idea from the 24 Hats Leadership Podcast and turn it into something you can try with your team on Monday.
cta_text: Ready to unlock your team's full potential? Let's start the conversation about what your people need.
about: The 24 Hats Leadership Blog is the written companion to the 24 Hats Leadership Podcast. Every week we pick one idea from the show and work it out in plain language.
24 Hats Leadership exists to unlock leaders' potential and fight for their highest good by guiding them toward healthy, present, and productive leadership.
